data.name: Logix Mono Pro 14-inch

capabilities.qualification_status: Engineering design target; tube/yoke/analog chain not yet production qualified.

specification.analog_chain: 4-bit index → 16×8-bit palette → external precision DAC ladder → external 25–30 MHz target video amplifier → CRT; independent HV/deflection/PSU.

manufacturing_requirements: Qualify bare CRT and yoke at 26.88 kHz horizontal / 60 Hz progressive; geometry, focus, 25–30 MHz video amplifier, grayscale calibration, insulation, EMC and thermal tests.
